emerging_themes: seasonal curves are sensitivity analysis tools, not status reports
the stress formula is a narrative choice, not an objective measurement
overengineered colonies have flat curves — the interesting signal is on the edge of viability
Monte Carlo --runs N is the convergent proposal for resilience margins
